description: Set a category's name and/or description in ONE language, leaving every other language as it is. Translate the text yourself — Obriym does not translate for MCP clients. Call list_content_locales first; the workspace's base language is refused (use update_category for it). A language needs a translated name before it can hold a description; description null clears it. Idempotent: repeating the same call changes nothing. update_category's translations field REPLACES the whole set, so use this tool to change a single language. Returns a warning when the CRM does not show that language yet. Echoes the workspace.

categoryId.description: The category id returned by list_categories.

description.description: The category description in this language. null or an empty string clears it. Cannot be stored for a language that has no translated name.

locale.description: The language to write, as an ISO 639-1 code. Call list_content_locales for the codes this workspace uses; never the workspace's base language.

name.description: The category name in this language. Required the first time a language is written.

name: upsert_category_translation
title: Set a category translation
